map.支持 URL 组件编码（encodeURIComponent）与完整 URL 解: Encode URL components with encodeURIComponent or decode a full URL.
map.URL 编码把非安全字符转为百分号加两位十六进制（空格转 %20、中文按 UTF: URL encoding turns unsafe chars into percent plus two hex digits (space -> %20, Chinese byte-by-byte UTF-8); encodeURIComponent encodes everything except A-Z a-z 0-9 and - _ . ! ~ * ' ( ); encodeURI keeps colon, slash, question, hash, brackets, @ etc. as structural chars to preserve full URL semantics; decoding is the reverse, and illegal percent sequences should be kept as-is.
map.编码：对字符串进行 encodeURIComponent 编码。: Encoding: run encodeURIComponent on the string.
map.解码：对字符串进行 decodeURIComponent 解码。: Decoding: run decodeURIComponent on the string.
map.解析 URL：提取协议、主机、路径、查询参数等组成部分。: Parse URL: extract protocol, host, path, query parameters and other parts.
map.参数构造：把用户输入拼进查询参数前转义，避免 &/= 截断。: Parameter construction: escape user input before putting it into query params to avoid &/= truncation.
map.日志还原：把服务端记录的编码 URL 解码回可读地址便于排查。: Log restore: decode server-recorded encoded URLs back to readable addresses for troubleshooting.
map.接口联调：核对前端实际发送的请求行是否符合预期。: API debugging: verify the request line the frontend actually sends matches expectations.
map.encodeURIComponent → \"a%20b%26c%3D1\"，解: encodeURIComponent -> "a%20b%26c%3D1"; decode back to the original, space becomes %20, & = become %26 %3D.
map.后者转义更彻底（含 ?#/等），适合编码单个参数值；前者保留 URL 结构字符。: The latter escapes more thoroughly (including ?#/ etc.), good for a single param value; the former keeps URL structural chars.
map.RFC 3986 中 A-Za-z0-9 及 -_.~ 为安全字符，可原样保留。: RFC 3986 treats A-Z a-z 0-9 and - _ . ~ as safe and leaves them as-is.
map.多为服务端未按 UTF-8 解码，属服务端问题，本工具解码本身正确。: Usually the server did not decode as UTF-8; that is a server-side issue, the tool's decoding is correct.
